stories.title: Seven Turnovers. Two Points. Oregon Nearly Won a Game Nobody Wins.

headline.sub: Two points. Oregon nearly won a game nobody wins.

stories.dek: Seventeen teams have turned it over seven or more times since 2014. All lost. Oregon came closest, and on every other snap it played UCLA about even.
stories.image_alt: Seven turnovers, two points: UCLA 17, Oregon 15. Every team with seven or more giveaways since 2014 lost; Oregon came closest.

stories.title: BOOMER SOONER! What Did We Actually Learn?
stories.dek: Oklahoma beat No. 1 Texas while getting outgained by 144 yards. Its defense and special teams scored 14 points. Its offense scored 13.
stories.image_alt: Where the points came from: Oklahoma's offense scored 13 points, its defense and special teams 14; Texas's offense scored all 24.
